name: Highlights - Hacienda Fire Memorial Dedication Ceremony
agenda_text:
“Hacienda Fire”
  Memorial Dedication Ceremony
  January 7, 2017 - 11:00 a.m.

The La Habra Heights & Los Angeles County Fire Departments
are dedicating a monument and plaque to the six firefighters
who lost their lives on September 2, 1955, while fighting the
“Hacienda Fire” in the area that would become the City of La
Habra Heights.
   Agenda
  I. Call to Order
  II. Invocation
 III. National Anthem
 IV. Introduction / Recognitions
  V. Los Angeles County Assistant Chief Scott Jones Ret.
 VI. Speakers
  A. Mayor Kyle Miller
  B. La Habra Heights City Council
  C. Los Angeles County Supervisor Janice Hahn,
  District 4
  D. La Habra Heights Fire Chief Doug Graft
  E. Los Angeles County Fire Chief Daryl Osby
VII. Unveiling Monument
VIII. Flag Presentation
 IX. Closing
  X. Adjournment
 XI. Pictures
XII. Lunch
